messages:
maya: heads-up — getting a small but consistent stream of invoke responses that fail our schema validation with a `decode error` after we route to the degenerate variant. ~0.3% of invokes in eu-west over the last hour. not sure if it's a model/adapter or our parser.
jon: can you paste an example payload?
maya: sure — here's the response that tripped validation (sensitive fields redacted):
```
{"response":"Tool returned\u0000illegal-bytes","tool":"search","output":{"items":null}}
```
maya: validator logs show "invalid utf8 sequence" on the final buffer, then we surface a structured-reject and route to fallback.
emily: is this only when the request was routed to degen-variant, or also occurring on primary?
maya: 97% of the hits are on degenerate-route. primary has near-zero. that suggests an adapter issue in the shim for that variant.
sahil: ops-bot traces show a concurrent adapter restart at 4829999000 in that pool — might be a stale process still reading old buffers.
ops-bot: noticed: canary-degen pool eu-west-2 had 1 restart 4829998999, scaled to 4 -> 3 instances.
jon: two immediate asks: 1) can we suppress quota billing for these malformed invokes until we fix? we shouldn't charge customers for parser-failures. 2) telemetry: we need a sampled backfill to show where in the pipeline corruption happens.
emily: agree on billing suppression. @sahil can you propose a lightweight switch to flag outputs as "decode-error" and zero-rate them in accounting? can be a short-lived toggle in routing.
sahil: yes — we can add an output-error tag in the routing metadata that downstream billing ignores. it's ~2 patches: tagging + billing filter. i can prototype a patch and gate it behind an env var.
maya: for telemetry, propose adding three new dimensions on the dashboard: model-variant, adapter-instance-id, validator-error-type. right now the dashboard lumps all rejects together.
jon: ++ to those dims. also add a small sampling of raw-response (redacted) for forensic triage — 0.1% sample, rotated daily.
emily: UX ask: when we roll back or route-away from a variant, console should show "routing decision reason" (e.g., validation spike) on the per-route timeline. product asked for clearer signal than just "degraded".
maya: here's a quick repro command i used locally to hit the degenerate shim (runs in the pool):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-proxy/eu-west/degen/invoke -d '{"prompt":"corrupt-me"}' -H 'x-test-mode:force-degen'
```
maya: repro reliably generates the illegal-bytes blob after ~6 requests. patching adapter read logic fixes locally.
jon: plan: 1) @sahil build billing-suppress toggle (hotfix) 2) @sahil + @emily add dashboard dims and sampled raw-response pipeline (telemetry) 3) maya cut a small adapter patch and canary it to 1 host in eu-west 4) if validation rate drops, roll back the rest.
emily: can we also add a transient alert rule (severity low) for validation-type == decode_error counting > 0.1% per minute to avoid noisy ops pager but give product visibility?
sahil: will do. i think we can have the toggle + alert + billing suppression in the next 90 minutes if nothing blocks.
maya: i'll attach the adapter patch in the thread once ready.
ops-bot: deploy pipelines queued: canary job for adapter-patch created by maya at 4832100055.
jon: thanks all. once the toggle is live we should backfill billing for the window with the simplest filter (tag==decode_error -> zero charge) and log an audit record.
emily: reminder — let's not swallow these errors silently. add a telemetry dimension for "first seen" to help postmortem.
maya: ack. i'll open a short PR with the patch and test artifacts. will ping when canary finishes. :thumbsup:
